title: Old Museum Building, Brisbane
geometryBasis: The City Council-sourced 212-vertex footprint and original conservation plan determine the full T-shaped exterior. The cleared 2019 concert front and 2011 west tower detail fix the photographed brick profiles, exterior arches, verandah trim and lantern silhouette.
sectionBasis: The high concert and exhibition roofs span perpendicular volumes. At the street entrance the terrain is near datum. The surveyed composite field falls about five metres across the exhibition hall to the northeast, where the dark glazed brick basement is more exposed. Heights and minor ornament are photographic estimates.
limitations: The mapped building and both entrance compositions set the physical scope. The 2019 photograph documents the Concert Hall front and the 2011 photograph supplies surviving tower details.
Rear openings, fine ornament, tower height and roofs use estimates from the visible reference evidence and written survey.
The original relief remains unchanged. The basement contact follows the approximate local terrain.
